text:
aman: quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we've got a cluster of recurring items: scale+deploy overlaps, route flaps during node churn, and restore validation gaps. starting a single thread to capture owners + timelines. pls react with :hand: if you can own.

rachel: i'll take the backups/restore validation work for APAC. will draft a post-restore verification checklist and a small automated verifier. target: PR in 3 business days.
tom: i'll own the routing validation piece. plan: add a pre-scale route sanity check + an emergency rollback gating flag. will prototype a health-check script this week.
katherine: ops note — we've seen the same pattern in 4 of the last 7 incidents: config pushes during scale spikes. i'll prototype a CI check that fails deploys when autoscale > 20% in the last 10m.
ops-bot: created tickets: DR-523 (restore-verifier), NET-881 (route-sanity), CI-1407 (deploy-safety-check).
aman: good. let's be explicit on first drill and game-day: who runs the first restore drill, and do we want a scoped routing game-day or full multi-region game-day?
rachel: i'll run the restore drill for apac staging and invite platform + db eng. propose Thursday 08:00 UTC (1.5h).
tom: scoped routing game-day sounds right — simulate control-plane isolation in one region and validate automatic routing fallback. propose a 2hr window next Tue 14:00 UTC.
jin: FYI, I'll add a metric to observe: percentage of requests hitting fallback within 60s after route withdrawal. will add alert threshold at 90%.
katherine: for the deploy safety check, i'll add a short block in the pipeline: ```if autoscale_recent > 0.2: fail_deploy("scale overlap detected")``` will open a Playground RFC for discussion.
aman: timeline suggestion: rachel PR in 3 days -> tom health-check prototype in 5 days -> katherine CI check RFC in 4 days -> run restore drill next Thu -> routing game-day next Tue (post-health-check). objections?
rachel: sounds fine. i'll include these post-restore validation steps in the PR snippet: ```post-restore-verify:
- compare snapshot checksums (sample 100 keys)
- run read-only queries against primary
- verify worker kv warmup within 90s
- send success heartbeat to ops-bot
```
tom: health-check sketch: ```#!/bin/bash
# route sanity
curl -sf https://edge.example/health || exit 1
curl -sS https://internal-router/route-state | jq .active_routes
# fail if any route points to nil
```
jin: will wire the fallback metric and add a dashboard panel to the DR overview. tagging ops for visibility.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: DR-523 restore drill on 2026-06-17T08:00:00Z.
aman: onboarding note — please add owner names to each ticket and set due dates. I'm happy to track the remediation tracker doc and send a short summary to #incidents and #eng-sre when the PRs are merged.
katherine: volunteers for reviewer on my RFC? @tom @rachel please.
tom: i'll review. also adding a smoke test that'll run after any route rollback to validate model variant fallbacks.
rachel: confirmed i'll include a simple rollback command block in the runbook: ```# immediate route rollback
kubectl apply -f infra/stable-route.yaml -n infra
sleep 8
kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/router
```
aman: open questions left for next sync: (1) runbook ownership per region (2) who coordinates the on-call coverage during game-days (3) acceptance criteria for restore success. please add to the remediation tracker doc.
jin: adding acceptance criteria suggestion: checksum match >= 99.9% over sampled keys AND avg read latency within 20% of pre-incident baseline.
aman: great. i'll create the tracker, assign the tickets (DR-523 -> rachel, NET-881 -> tom, CI-1407 -> katherine), and set tentative deadlines (7-10 days). will post the one-pager with links to PRs and tickets once assigned. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
